question: Which three recipient addresses received the largest summed value in Transfer logs emitted by 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 (the token contract) on chain 8453 in the pinned inclusive window?

definitions.window: Use the exact quoted fromBlock through toBlock, both inclusive. Do not substitute a moving latest block.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.event: event Transfer(address indexed from,address indexed to,uint256 value)
definitions.metric: log-rank over Transfer logs emitted by 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 only: key indexed to, sum value in raw token units. Exclude recipient 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Include every indexed from (sender). Keep only positive totals.
definitions.ordering: Descending summed value; ties by ascending numeric 20-byte address. Return up to 3 unique entries; fewer when fewer eligible recipients; empty only for a complete zero-activity set.
